extensionDescription.message: Capture, edit and save screenshots locally. Select a region, element, visible screen or full page.

chooseMode.message: What would you like to capture?

regionDesc.message: Drag around exactly what you need

elementDesc.message: Point and click on a page element

fullDesc.message: Everything down the page, in one image

visibleDesc.message: The tab exactly as you see it

settingsIntro.message: Make capture and saving work your way.

shortcutHelp.message: Open Chrome settings below and find CaptureSok. Click the pencil next to a command and press your preferred keys. Use Ctrl or Alt with another key. Keys reserved by Chrome or your operating system may not be available.

shortcutMissing.message: Some shortcuts are unassigned. Set them in shortcut settings.

dragHint.message: Drag to select · Esc to cancel

elementHint.message: Click to capture · ↑ Parent · ↓ Retarget · Esc to cancel

minimumSelection.message: Select an area at least 3 pixels wide and high.

autoDownloadDesc.message: Save to Downloads using your selected format.

previewDesc.message: When off, automatically save using the default format.

copied.message: Image copied. Paste it with Ctrl+V.

copyFailed.message: Could not copy the image. Save it as a file instead.

downloadFailed.message: The download was interrupted. Please try again.

elementLimit.message: Element capture saves only the portion visible on screen.

fullLimit.message: Keep the page still while it scrolls. Press Esc to cancel.

restricted.message: This page cannot be captured. Open a regular web page. Local files require Allow access to file URLs in extension settings.

busy.message: A capture is already running. Finish or cancel it first.

tooLarge.message: This page exceeds the safe image size limit. Capture the visible screen or smaller regions instead.

noResult.message: This image was deleted or expired. Please capture again.

saveFailed.message: Could not save the image. Please try again.

storageFailed.message: Not enough space for a temporary image. Close unused capture tabs.

captureFailed.message: Capture failed. Reload the page and try again.

invalidMode.message: This capture mode is not supported.

invalidSelection.message: The selected area is invalid. Please select it again.

pageLoading.message: Wait for the page to finish loading and try again.

pageChanged.message: Capture stopped because the tab, viewport or page changed. Try again when the page is stable.

interrupted.message: The capture connection was interrupted. Please try again.
